# Washington State Health Care Authority

> > Official health care programs and benefits administration for Washington State, including Apple Health (Medicaid), SEBB employee benefits, and public health initiatives.

The Washington State Health Care Authority (HCA) administers health care programs for residents, employees, and retirees. The site provides comprehensive information on Apple Health (Medicaid) eligibility, School Employees Benefits Board (SEBB) programs, provider billing guidelines, and state health initiatives including the Cascade Select public option and Hepatitis C elimination efforts.

## Key Topics

- Apple Health (Washington Medicaid program)
- Medicaid eligibility determination
- SEBB (School Employees Benefits Board)
- SSI-related medical programs
- Self-settled trusts and irrevocable trusts
- Medically needy programs and spenddown
- Long-term care eligibility
- WAC regulations (Washington Administrative Code)
- Behavioral health services
- Veterans Benefits Enhancement Program (VBEP)
- Income and asset rules
- Cascade Select public option
- Provider billing and reimbursement
- End-of-life care and advance directives

## Apple Health (Medicaid) Programs

- [General requirements that apply to all Apple Health programs](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-help-others-apply-and-access-apple-health/general-requirements-apply-all-apple-health-programs): Universal eligibility requirements for all Apple Health programs
- [Apple Health client booklets](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-need-medical-dental-or-vision-care/apple-health-client-booklets): Multilingual client handbooks for Apple Health (Medicaid) members
- [Veterans and family members](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-need-medical-dental-or-vision-care/veterans-and-family-members): Apple Health benefits for veterans and families through VBEP
- [Changes of circumstance effect on eligibility](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-help-others-apply-and-access-apple-health/changes-circumstance-effect-eligibility): How circumstance changes affect Apple Health eligibility and coverage
- [Allowable medical expenses](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-help-others-apply-and-access-apple-health/allowable-medical-expenses): Allowable medical expenses for spenddown and long-term care eligibility
- [Treatment of Income chart](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-help-others-apply-and-access-apple-health/treatment-income-chart): Income type treatment chart for SSI-related and medically needy programs

## Eligibility Worker Resources

- [Income overview 4: exclusions and allocations continued](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-help-others-apply-and-access-apple-health/income-overview-4-exclusions-and-allocations-continued): Apple Health income exclusions and allocations for eligibility workers
- [300 Series reason codes](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-help-others-apply-and-access-apple-health/300-series-reason-codes): 300-series eligibility determination reason codes for Apple Health

## School Employee Benefits (SEBB)

- [EyeMed](https://www.hca.wa.gov/employee-retiree-benefits/sebb-virtual-benefits-fair/eyemed): EyeMed vision insurance benefits for SEBB school employees
- [Spousal coverage surcharge](https://www.hca.wa.gov/employee-retiree-benefits/school-employees/spousal-coverage-surcharge): SEBB spousal coverage surcharge requirements and attestation process

## HCA Programs and Initiatives

- [Cascade Select (public option)](https://www.hca.wa.gov/about-hca/programs-and-initiatives/cascade-select-public-option): Cascade Select public option health insurance program information
- [Hepatitis C elimination](https://www.hca.wa.gov/billers-providers-partners/program-information-providers/hepatitis-c-elimination): HCA Hepatitis C elimination initiative and Mavyret dispensing updates
- [End of life care](https://www.hca.wa.gov/about-hca/programs-and-initiatives/making-informed-health-care-decisions/end-life-care): Guide to advance directives, POLST, and Death with Dignity Act
- [TARGET](https://www.hca.wa.gov/billers-providers-partners/program-information-providers/target): TARGET system for behavioral health treatment reporting and assessment
- [Activities and oversight](https://www.hca.wa.gov/about-hca/other-administrative-activities/activities-and-oversight): HCA audits and oversight activities for Apple Health (Medicaid) funds

## WAC Regulations - Trust Rules

- [WAC 182-516-0110 Self-settled trusts overview](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-help-others-apply-and-access-apple-health/wac-182-516-0110-self-settled-trusts-overview): WAC 182-516-0110: Overview of self-settled trust asset rules
- [WAC 182-516-0130 Irrevocable self-settled trusts established on or after August 11, 1993](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-help-others-apply-and-access-apple-health/wac-182-516-0130-irrevocable-self-settled-trusts-established-or-after-august-11-1993): WAC 182-516-0130: Irrevocable self-settled trust regulations for Medicaid
- [WAC 182-516-0125 Irrevocable pooled self-settled trusts for a disabled client established on or after August 11, 1993](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-help-others-apply-and-access-apple-health/wac-182-516-0125-irrevocable-pooled-self-settled-trusts-disabled-client-established-or-after-august-11-1993): WAC 182-516-0125: Pooled trust rules for disabled Medicaid clients

- [WAC 182-524-0600 Payments](https://www.hca.wa.gov/free-or-low-cost-health-care/i-help-others-apply-and-access-apple-health/wac-182-524-0600-payments): WAC 182-524-0600: Payment rules for COFA islander health care
